resources.string: Natural Korean text-to-speech for any app. Runs on your phone, no Google services needed.
Ko TTS is your default speech engine.
Ko TTS isn\'t your default engine yet. Apps that ask for Ko TTS by name still use it. To use it everywhere, set \"Preferred engine\" to Ko TTS.
No voice model yet. Download one below. Use Wi-Fi: it\'s a big file, and it\'s needed only once.
The download didn\'t finish. Check your connection and try again.
A downloaded file was corrupted (%s). Try again.
The voice model\'s files are gone from this phone. Download it again.
Ready: compact model installed. Speech works offline.
Ready: full-precision model installed. Speech works offline.
Compact was as accurate as full precision in our speech-recognition tests, and it\'s faster. Full precision is Supertone\'s original release.
Online voices send the text you hear to that service, using your own key. Nothing is sent unless you pick an online source.
